as_told.title: Deep underground military bases (DUMBs) book by Richard Sauder

plain: Michels says underground military bases exist across the United States, called DUMBs, short for deep underground military bases, and that a writer named Richard Sauder wrote a book about them that he recommends. He brings it up himself on two episodes. In one, with a journalist who says he located a UFO base in Arizona, Michels says the book backs up that claim, though there he gives the author's name as Larry Sanders.
